caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, metallic bell suspended in an ornate frame. The bell is predominantly greenish with accents of brown and lighter shades, indicative of a patina on aged metal. The frame holding the bell is detailed, with sculpted curved arms and structural supports, primarily colored in shades of brown and hints of blue, simulating the appearance of tarnished or weathered bronze or brass. The top of the bell features a rounded finial, and the clapper is partially visible underneath the bell. The two side supports are bolt-mounted, and the entire assembly is rendered with a high degree of realism, showing shading and highlights. The background is plain and unadorned, with the artist’s signature “L.B. HARTMANN” in the lower right corner.
title: Locomotive Bell
